caption: If you’re tired of constantly thinking about what to make for lunch, this series is for you 🤍 Day 19/20 — Broccoli Balls 🥦 Ingredients: • 6oz broccoli • 1 potato • 1 egg • 2 tbsp shredded cheese • 1 tsp olive oil • 1 tbsp breadcrumbs • Salt (1 year+) • ¼ tsp black pepper • ½ tsp onion powder Directions: 	1.	Steam broccoli and potato until soft 	2.	Mash together in a bowl 	3.	Add egg, cheese, olive oil, breadcrumbs and seasoning and combine well 	4.	Form into small balls and lay on a baking sheet 	5.	Spray with olive oil 	6.	Bake at 360°F for 20 minutes, flipping halfway Serve immediately 🤍 Why it’s so good for your toddler: 🥦 Broccoli — vitamin C and iron for a strong immune system 🥔 Potato — slow-release energy to keep them going all afternoon 🥚 Egg — protein for growth and development 🧀 Cheese — calcium for strong bones This recipe is part of MunchMind, an app with 200+ recipes, personalized meal plans and grocery lists designed to take away the stress of feeding little ones 🌿 Follow for more toddler lunches like this 🤍 #toddlerlunch #toddlerfood #pickyeater #healthytoddler #babyledweaning
